a.xlink:title: Abstract state of a Task (State pattern).
State of a task that has a participant but has not been started (State pattern).
State of a task that is ready to be assigned (State pattern).
End state of a task that was cancelled (State pattern).
End state of a task that was finished successfully (State pattern).
Starting state of every new task (State pattern).
State of a task that was turned down (State pattern).
State of a task that is being worked on (State pattern).
